player_prompt.intro:
Nang Player {player_id} ni. Nang Memory Game khelgi khudammi.
Nang gi lakpa, board da leiriba card sagi khudingmak pair khudingmakta thokpa khudingmak nang gi opponent singgi.
Nang gi turn da, card 2 ta flip toukhiba row leiriba column number singbu first leiriba second card bu respectively '[0 1 1 0]' gi matamda, first card row 0 leiriba column 1 da, leiriba second card row 1 leiriba column 0 da.
Card 2 ta match toukhiba, nang point 1 amasung card 2 ta face up toukhiba. Match toukhibasu, card 2 ta face down toukhiba, e.g. '.'.
Game over toukhiba, pair khudingmak sagi khudingmakta thokpa toukhiba.
